question.text: Unlisted equity securities are initially valued at:

answer.text: Cost; subsequently at Fair Market Value (FMV) by an independent valuer

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 269, unlisted equity securities should be valued initially at cost and thereafter at Fair Market Value determined by the independent valuer appointed by the Trustee or Investment Manager. The Trap: Zero, face value, and book-value-only ignore the source-prescribed initial-cost and subsequent independent-valuer FMV rule. Note: Hold to the source rule: initial cost first, then FMV by an independent valuer appointed by the Trustee or Investment Manager.
